correctness.rationale: The formal Euler ratio is R=F_t/C_t=E(x)^{t^2}/E(x^t)^t. If t=p^a, H=E(x)^{p^a}/E(x^{p^a}) lies in 1+pZ[[x]] by Frobenius, so R=H^{p^a} lies in 1+p^{a+1}Z[[x]]. Mod p^2 the least coefficient of H-1 not divisible by p^2 occurs at x^{p^{a-1}} with residue -p, via lifting Frobenius E(x)^{p^{a-1}} congruent E(x^{p^{a-1}}) mod p. Therefore the corresponding difference coefficient is -p^{a+1} mod p^{a+2}, while all earlier ones vanish at that precision. For t=p^a m with p∤m and m>1, reduce R mod p to E(y)^{m²}/E(y^m)^m, y=x^{p^{2a}}, whose first nonconstant coefficient is -m². Since d_t(1)=-t², these witnesses determine the complete integer gcd. All formal power series, including p=2, are justified.
